open_findings: No independent review of any module (MGR-07 not satisfied)
The blueprint's 374-item checklist remains NOT VERIFIED pending review; CHECKLIST_STATUS.md distinguishes test evidence from full acceptance
A basic lint/type/test CI workflow exists; deployment security, model lifecycle, data-governance and compliance controls remain unimplemented
Reference scenarios use synthetic single-asset GBM and separate economic/hedge balance sheets; price and policy response rules are not empirically calibrated
Black-Scholes marks and conditional risk freeze the closing rate; no joint stochastic-rate Q valuation or full dynamic-policy risk forecast is implemented
scope_enabled: Deterministic macro time engine: calendar, seeds, point-in-time data, shocks (PR-003)
Classical GBM/Heston and macro-conditioned (non-neural) path simulation (PR-004/009)
Delta and CVaR-trained MLP hedge simulation against synthetic paths (PR-007)
End-to-end demonstration and monthly StepHooks scenario with online delta/MLP hedging, conditional portfolio risk and evidence export (PR-011/014/015)
Government taxes/transfers/bonds and a scalar central-bank policy-rate agent (PR-012)
Single-firm labor/goods quantity clearing with ledger settlement (PR-013)
Reproducible benchmark/retraining stress recipes and exact artifact replay (PR-016/017)
Exact budget-feasible price discovery, inventory and atomic market settlement (PR-018)
Publication-lagged price/output policy feedback coupled to market and hedge financing with explicit opening/closing rate timing (PR-019)
Crossed retraining/shared macro-market banks across publication, payroll and supply-shock scenarios with conditional-CVaR diagnostics (PR-020)
Matched current-rate feature ablation with independent macro training banks, variable-rate differentiable accounting and optimization diagnostics (PR-021)
scope_prohibited: Live trading, order routing, or any connection to a brokerage
Use of real (non-synthetic) market or portfolio data
Any claim of regulatory, model-risk, or security certification

failure_modes: Synthetic one-firm economy and classical single-asset GBM; no empirical identification.
Each bank has one macro path; its CVaR is conditional on that realization, not unconditional.
The endpoint averages conditional cell CVaRs; losses are not pooled across banks/models.
Few training/bank seed levels make percentile coverage unreliable; no exact guarantee.
Crossed resampling retains training rows/shared macro-market columns, not independent cells.
Bonferroni allocates nominal tail error across scenarios, not calibrated marginal coverage.
MLP trains once per replicate on constant-rate GBM and receives no rate/macro features.
Delta uses only current rates and fixed pricing volatility; marks assume flat future rates.
Economic and hedge books remain separate; macro has no feedback from asset/hedge wealth.
Scenario comparisons diagnose sensitivity and do not identify optimal monetary policy.
No scientific/independent review or deployment approval is provided.
model_cards.input_schema_summary: Per path per step: (log(S_t / strike), fraction of time-to-maturity remaining in [0, 1], previous holding in [-1, 1]), each a float32 scalar. Output: a tanh-bounded target holding in [-1, 1].
model_cards.intended_use: Research demonstration of CVaR-based deep hedging (Buehler et al. 2019) on synthetic single-asset European-option GBM paths. Not calibrated to, or validated against, real market data.
model_cards.metric_uncertainty_note: Bank-averaged conditional CVaR for one retraining; exploratory crossed intervals are study-level diagnostics.
model_cards.model_type: Feedforward MLP hedging policy (3 inputs, 2 hidden layers of 32 units, tanh-bounded scalar output)
model_cards.prohibited_use: Any live trading, order routing, or real-money hedging decision. Any use outside the single-asset European vanilla call/put GBM setting it was trained on (not evaluated under Heston, jumps, multiple assets, or real market microstructure).
model_cards.training_data_summary: 1500 synthetic GBM paths (prometheus.stochastica.gbm), physical-measure, seed=1; no empirical/historical data. Policy seed=0; named training stream=macro-study-training-paths.
